findings.extraction_problem: Independent sampling improves some cases but remains incompetent; all four nominal stochastic cases fail.
findings.training_sufficiency: Not established. The changing stochastic pilot had 393/1024 successes in its last cohort; 20 PPO update batches are insufficient evidence of convergence.
findings.reward_incentive: Finite success termination discards positive remaining-horizon rewards; verified failures outreturn successful matched scripts in 10/19 cases. Corrected before scaling.

correction: Reward-only ideal remaining-horizon success credit at completed dwell; no task, action, script, force, deadline, or reset changes.
next_action: Fresh 22-cohort uniform v3 run; 10,326,272 charged transitions, then fixed deterministic development competence evaluation.

checks.bare_pytest_launcher: Attempted; Windows Application Control blocked pytest.exe. Same environment python -m pytest passed.

scope_and_limitations: One frozen trained network, one paired development seed; not a unique causal explanation for all learning weakness.
Reward correction removes observed incentive counterexamples and preserves all physical trajectories, but does not itself improve learned behavior.
The original pilot remains 0/84 deterministic development completions; no final seeds or combinations opened.
Longer training and the predeclared competence gate have not yet run.
